QuestInfo.name: Terminating the Dark Force.
QuestInfo.0: I should go visit General Maestro at the Omega Sector.
QuestInfo.2: Just like the way General Maestro instructed, I gathered up the #bDull Crystals#k and #bDark Crystal Ores#k from the Drumming Bunnies. Hopefully this'll stop the bunnies for a while, but this ain't over. I wonder when peace will actually settle on the Eos Tower.
QuestInfo.1:
General Maestro of Omega Sector doesn't have a perfect solution, but he wants you to collect #b30 Dull Crystals#k from the Drummer Bunnies in Eos Tower.


#i4031140##t4031140# #b#c4031140##k / 30

0.0: I've been waiting for you to come back here. Utilizing the power of a language expert, I've been able to research #b#t4031136##k for the last few days. Through that, I found out something that may interest you... and of course, I'll need your help once more. What do you think... do you want to do this?

yes.0: The most important part of this is missing, so the perfect way to turn these 'monsters' back to dolls isn't available, yet. What we DO know is that the #t4004004# that you'll find with #t4031135# from time to time again has something to do with all this.
yes.1: Go to the 67th floor of the Eos Tower again, defeat Drummer Bunnies, and return with #b30 #t4031135#s#k. This should pose no problem for you. I'll be waiting.

no.0: I thought I could count on you to take care of this mission, but I guess not. This is a discreet project, one that cannot be advertised to total strangers, so... if you ever change your mind about this, then please talk to me, okay?

1.0: Hmmm... okay! I can try different things with this many to work with. Here... I have to reward you well for your job well done. I'm a general, so if you want anything, just say it. Hmmm? You don't need anything right now? Hahaha... I understand. Here, please take this!

yes.0: I can't thank you enough for helping me out this much. I'll never forget all your help. This doesn't mean everything's been solved, but I can safely say that the path to a solution has now been established. Hope to see you around here from time to time again. Bye.

item.0: I'm still waiting. Go to the 67th floor of the Eos Tower again, defeat Drummer Bunnies, and return with #b30 #t4031135#s#k. This should pose no problem for you. Good luck.
